gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-lexend-peta: Lemon Milk's loose, wide tracking gives it a rolling-ball pen friendliness. Lexend Peta follows with curves that never thin and a big x-height, so the two feel like friendly neighbors, one showy and one approachable.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-lexend-tera: Rounded, open letters with a rolling-ball pen trail: that's Lemon Milk. Lexend Tera brings a plotter-pen line and stepping-stone spacing, so the page gets one rounded, friendly voice and one contemporary, clean one.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta draws ribbon-like strokes of constant width, with tall-bodied small letters and wide tracking. And Lemon Milk, loose and rounded up top, makes a friendlier, showier partner for it.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-gf-montserrat-alte: Loose and rounded, Lemon Milk takes the stage with a rolling-ball pen's single-width trail. But Montserrat Alternates handles the steadier work, with round letters whose rims match the stems.
gen-dafont-maxwell-author: Clean and rounded-nib smooth, Maxwell holds one constant stroke with no swelling at the ends. Author is the dignified serif, thin strokes only slightly lighter than the thick, better in compact snippets.
gen-dafont-maxwell-fs-sentient: Crisp and wire-like, Maxwell holds a single constant stroke from the first letter to the last. Sentient's pinched apertures and slightly thinner crossbars suit modest helpings alongside it.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-gambetta: Nasalization floats its letters well apart, with a caliper-opened c. Gambetta lets wide channels lead into each counter, so extended reading feels graceful and bookish, its weight shifting noticeably but never dramatically.
gen-dafont-nasalization-lora: Big, loose, friendly: Nasalization floats a large-bodied lowercase on short ascenders. Lora, with a moderate lowercase and modest hairline thinning, settles into a literary, bookish rhythm over a full page.
gen-dafont-nasalization-noto-serif: Friendly and approachable, Nasalization has a pipe-like body to every stroke and letters floating well apart. Noto Serif adds the mild swelling of a worn felt marker, giving the pipe-like heading a literary partner.
gen-dafont-neogrey-fs-bespoke-serif: Bespoke Serif reads authoritative and dignified, its thin strokes about half the weight of the thick ones. Neogrey sits apart from it, spaghetti-thin and geometric, each letter alone.
